statement: On an application for registration, ASIC may give the company an ACN, register the company, and issue a certificate stating the company's name, ACN, type, that it is registered under the Act, the State or Territory of registration, and the date of registration; the company comes into existence as a body corporate at the beginning of the day on which it is registered.
caveat: Subsection 1274(7A) governs the certificate's evidentiary value. The company's name is the name specified in the certificate, and the company remains in existence until deregistered under Chapter 5A.
